masterGain.description: The master gain the mix path applies over every emitter (1 = unity), bounded by MaxLevel.

defaultSpeakerRadius.description: The audible support radius a point emitter coalesces to when its row declares no attenuation/radius.

defaultCurve.description: The falloff curve a point emitter coalesces to: CurveSmoothstep or CurveLinear.

defaultBedFadeSeconds.description: The presence slew bound a bed coalesces to when it declares none.

listener.description: The listener policy: ListenerFocus (the active view camera's pose listens), seat:<n> (that seat's view camera), or a declared camera name — so a stage or museum world can pin its listener without touching the runtime.

cues.description: Gets the cue table. The absence-coalesce lives in the accessor for the same reason Response's does.

items.description: One world-event → sound binding — a row of the Audio section's cue table: when the named engine event fires, the referenced patch voices through a short-lived transient emitter placed per Placement. Event tokens are either a published engine mechanism (EventTokens) or a cue name emitted by one of the same world's rules. A genre can therefore bind authored rule events without widening the engine vocabulary.

event.description: The published engine token or rule-emitted cue name.

patchId.description: The referenced Name the cue voices (must resolve).

placement.description: Where the cue sounds: PlacementAtSite (spatial, at the event's world position — the shimmer's audio twin; events with no derivable site fall back to the listener), PlacementListener (UI feedback — rides the listener pose, so distance 0 renders full gain and the mixer's on-top-of-listener pan hold centers it), or emitter:<name> (sounds from the named speaker's resolved pose and support radius).

gainThousandths.description: The cue's voice gain in thousandths (1000 = unity), or null for unity. Bounded by MaxLevel × 1000 — the shared audio gain ceiling in the cue table's integer unit.
